title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Total Score – SF save – BO value synchronized
description: AC 2.1.1 — CRUD / Regression — A Total Score saved in SF is read unchanged in Back Office.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Back Office.
- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.
- The BO internal score setting is ON.
- Student A's Total Score is blank.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff enters -10.5 in Student A's Total Score in Salesforce and saves the report.\n2. HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's same Lesson Report in Back Office.
steps_result: 1. Salesforce displays Total Score -10.5.\n2. Back Office displays Total Score -10.5.

preconditions:

title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Score details – Two students – Values remain isolated
description: AC 2.1.1 — Decision Table / Data Integrity — Each student's score detail remains independent in a group lesson.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.
- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.
- A group lesson has Student A and Student B.
- Student A's Total Score and Test Result are blank.
- Student B's Total Score is 100.0.
- Student B's Test Result is 92.5.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff enters Total Score -10.5 and Test Result 8.5 for Student A and saves the report.\n2. HQ or CM Staff opens Student B's detail in the same lesson.
steps_result: 1. Student A's detail displays -10.5 and 8.5.\n2. Student B retains Total Score 100.0 and Test Result 92.5.
steps_data: 1. student = A; total_score = -10.5; test_result = 8.5\n2. student = B; expected_total_score = 100.0; expected_test_result = 92.5

title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Test Result – Single-field update – Other scores retained
description: AC 2.1.1 — CRUD / Regression — Updating Test Result does not change Total Score or inactive Lesson Quiz data.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Back Office.
- The BO internal score setting is ON.
- Student A's Lesson Quiz is 80%.
- Student A's Total Score is 10.0.
- Student A's Test Result is 8.0.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff changes Student A's Test Result to 9.5 and saves the report.\n2. HQ or CM Staff reopens Student A's detail.
steps_result: 1. Test Result displays 9.5.\n2. Total Score remains 10.0 and the stored Lesson Quiz value remains 80%.

title: [Koyu] Learner App – Student score detail – Published report – SF-originated values displayed
description: AC 2.1.1 / AC 2.1.2 — State Transition / Component — A student sees exact SF-originated values after normal report publication.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.
- Student A is logged in to the Koyu Learner App.
- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.
- The App internal score setting is ON.
- Student A's lesson and Lesson Report are published.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff saves Total Score -20.5 and Test Result 15.0 for Student A in Salesforce.\n2. Student A opens the published Lesson Report in the Learner App.
steps_result: 1. Salesforce stores the two values.\n2. Total Score displays -20.5 and Test Result displays 15.0; Lesson Quiz is absent and neither score is editable.
steps_data: 1. total_score = -20.5; test_result = 15.0; source = SF\n2. expected_total_score = -20.5; expected_test_result = 15.0

title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Invalid Total Score – Existing cross-surface values retained
description: AC 2.1.1 — Negative / Data Integrity — A blocked Total Score save does not overwrite the prior synchronized values.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Back Office.
- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.
- The BO internal score setting is ON.
- Student A's Total Score is 10.0 in both staff surfaces.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff enters 10.25 in Student A's Total Score in Salesforce and saves the report.\n2. HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Report in Back Office.
steps_result: 1. Save is blocked with the active-locale validation message.\n2. Total Score remains 10.0.

title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Score detail – SF update after BO view – Refreshed value displayed
description: AC 2.1.1 — Regression — Back Office does not retain a stale score after an SF update and refresh.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.
- HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Report in the Koyu Back Office.
- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.
- The BO internal score setting is ON.
- Student A's Total Score is 10.0.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff changes Student A's Total Score to 11.0 in Salesforce and saves the report.\n2. HQ or CM Staff refreshes Student A's open Lesson Report in Back Office.
steps_result: 1. Salesforce displays Total Score 11.0.\n2. Back Office displays Total Score 11.0 rather than the earlier 10.0 value.

title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Independent scores – Total Score changed – Test Result not calculated
description: Scope — Decision Table / Negative — Changing Total Score does not calculate or replace Test Result.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.
- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.
- Student A's Total Score is 100.0.
- Student A's Test Result is 75.5.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff changes Student A's Total Score to 50.0 and saves the report.\n2. HQ or CM Staff reads Student A's Test Result.
steps_result: 1. Total Score displays 50.0.\n2. Test Result remains 75.5 and no percentage or other calculated value appears.
